_about: Curated numbers quoted on coupled-snapshot.html. Every entry is copied from the saved results.json of the completed run, or recomputed from gauges.csv and checked against it (see data-checks.json). A synthetic observing-system simulation experiment on a real static river topology; no measured discharge or chemistry. Raw arrays, run logs and internal reports are not published.

_network.status: PROVISIONAL outlet component of the pinned region-74 static network; NOT a validated Mississippi study boundary
_network.data_status: real network topology, K and X; SYNTHETIC forcing and virtual observations; no measured Mississippi discharge or chemistry

design.parameter_box_rule: prior mean +/- 2.0 prior sd, identical in every stage
design.holdout_status: REUSED evaluation set: these ten large-river reaches were already scored in three earlier five-parameter experiments. They support a paired comparison and are NOT a pristine blind test. The truth vector, the parameterisation and the discharge observations are new
design.observation_colocation: both data types are observed at the SAME 30 training reaches and evaluated at the SAME 10 held-out reaches; real chemistry stations are far sparser than discharge gauges, which this design does not represent
design.generated_noise: NONE; the virtual observations equal the noise-free truth exactly
design.assumed_error_independence: diagonal: independent across gauges AND between the two data types at the same gauge. Independence is an OSSE assumption; a real error covariance depends on the measurement protocol at each site.
design._assumed_error_independence_note: Wording corrected for publication on 2026-09-22. The run's design.json carried the same diagonal assumption but justified it with a general claim about how concentrations are measured; that claim is protocol-dependent and is not repeated here. The assumed covariance used in the fit is unchanged.
design.objective: 0.5*sum_Q((log Qw_pred - log yQ)/sigma_Q)^2 + 0.5*sum_C((log C_pred - log yC)/sigma_C)^2 + 0.5*sum_free((theta - prior mean)/prior sd)^2; the three costs are reported separately
design.optimizer: SciPy L-BFGS-B on the box with JAX value_and_grad, maxiter=500, gtol=1e-9, ftol=1e-15

starts.name: start_prior_mean
starts.description: the prior mean in every coordinate

starts.name: start_sign_flipped
starts.description: 1.2 prior sd with the OPPOSITE sign to the truth offset in all eight coordinates

starts.name: start_uniform_inflation
starts.description: 1.5 prior sd up in every coordinate; also probes the concentration scale direction

fixed_fields: R_ref from 1.0 mm/day uniform runoff depth
Rc_ref at 1.0 mg/L of that water
both storage-anomaly spatial patterns and their normalisations
design.weak_prior_control: one prespecified repeat from start_prior_mean with prior sd multiplied by 3.0; same box, same data, so the admissibility certificate is unchanged

prespecified_criteria.rationale: the smallest truth offset from the prior mean is 0.579 prior sd, so an estimate that reverted to the prior mean is 'not recovered' for every parameter; identifiability numbers are reported, not gated

design.state_interpretation: delta_S is an anomaly relative to the equilibrium storage of the CURRENT inputs (provisional reading of the archived April-2026 derivation), NOT S[t+1]-S[t]. This is a mathematical snapshot control: no time integration, no dynamic mass-conservation test and no physical validation of the storage chemistry
design.forward_model: Qw = (I-N)^-1 R + M^-1 K^-1 dSw with M = XN+I-X; Qc = (I-Phi N)^-1 Phi Rc + Phi M^-1 K^-1 dSc (Equation 42 unchanged, including the placement of Phi); C = 1000 Qc/Qw
design.chemical_input_independence: Rc = c[region] * Rc_ref is never multiplied by the fitted water multiplier or by any observed discharge. Rc_ref is a FIXED reference field set to 1 mg/L of the reference water, so the effective input concentration at truth is c/a (1.185 mg/L west, 0.933 mg/L east). The proportionality Rc_ref ~ R_ref is a documented choice of reference field, not an imposed link between the fitted input multipliers
design.water_storage_basis: fixed signed pattern tanh((lat-median lat)/2.5 deg) times the conservative equilibrium water storage K (I-N)^-1 R_ref, rescaled once for the admissibility certificate; units m^3
design.chemical_storage_basis: fixed signed pattern tanh((lat-median lat)/2.5 deg) * tanh((lon-median lon)/5.0 deg) times the conservative equilibrium chemical mass (5/3) K flux_floor, rescaled once; units kg

identifiability_at_truth.note: Local numerical rank of the prior-scaled data Jacobian evaluated at the synthetic truth. Not a global or reach-by-reach identifiability statement.
identifiability_at_truth.registered_analytic_prediction: concentration is exactly invariant under a -> lambda a, c -> lambda c, b_w -> lambda b_w, b_c -> lambda b_c, so the concentration-only data Jacobian has an exact null direction (1,1,1,1,0,0,b_w,b_c) that the discharge data must break

information.note: Gauss-Newton linearisation in prior-scaled units, not a sampled posterior.

gates.failed_criterion: train concentration noise-scaled log RMSE 0.116 against the prespecified threshold 0.1

tests.note: pytest on the tested Python package, recorded in the run's logs; the package, not this page, is the scientific source of truth.

limits: Synthetic forcing and virtual observations; no measured discharge or chemistry
One noise-free realization; three starts are not a coverage or robustness claim
An eight-parameter reduction; per-reach source/rate confounding is NOT resolved
Snapshot algebra only: no time integration and no temporal-conservation test
One fixed spatial mode per storage field, not a general storage state
The chemical total-storage identity Sc_eq = (5/3) K Qc_eq is our provisional reading; the draft states no chemical equilibrium-storage identity
Both data types are co-located at the same reaches; real chemistry stations are far sparser than discharge gauges
The ten held-out reaches were scored in three earlier experiments: a paired evaluation, not a pristine blind test
Gauss-Newton covariance is an approximate prior-regularised local linearisation
Positive-flux and positive-storage bounds are algebraic; they are not evidence that the storage chemistry of Equation 42 is physically correct
not_claimed: elementwise positivity of the draft's storage operator
physical validation of the storage chemistry of Equation 42
